sources.description: Lightweight loop engineering state kernel for long-running AI agent teams. Agent-loop agnostic across Codex, Claude Code, and other coding agents, with durable goals, quota-aware auto-wake, executable todos, evidence logs, and verifiable handoffs.

Loop Engineering: a curated field guide to designing recurring AI agent and coding-agent loops — patterns, loop contracts, runnable examples, and resources above prompt, context, and harness engineering.
Manage AI agent teams locally using CLI, OAuth, and API tools to simulate a virtual company with autonomous workflows.
Build automated agent systems that remove manual prompting by applying loop engineering principles for efficient software development.
Design and audit autonomous agent loops using a tested framework for triggers, verification, guardrails, and human escalation.
Python simulations and mathematical modeling for the Human Agentic Loyalty Loop (HALL) and Net Human-Agent Score (NHAS).
Automate running an AI-driven company using multiple agents through a bash loop that manages tasks and decisions from the terminal.

Curated, verified survey of the agent harness — the layer around an LLM   (loop, tools, memory, context, runtime) that turns it into an agent. 116   papers + Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / OpenHands tools + Anthropic /   OpenAI / Karpathy essays. Agent = Model + Harness.
